- `filter[property_id]` — Comma-separated property ids: bills with a line item on any of them.
- `filter[tag_id]` — Comma-separated tag ids: bills carrying any of them.
- `filter[has_work_order]` — `true` / `false`: whether the bill is attached to a work order.
- `filter[archived]` — `false` (default) hides archived bills, `true` returns only archived ones, `all` returns both.
